description: Sever the account's HubSpot connection. The other half of cromanion_set_lead_destination's `hubspot` option: you can point leads at a CRM, so you can take them back out. Refused while any site on the account still delivers there — change those destinations first, or the forms would keep working while every lead failed delivery. Reconnecting is NOT a tool: it is an OAuth consent screen only your human can click, so treat this as one-way and say so before you call it. Needs the integrations permission.

siteId.description: Which site this call is about. Only needed when your credential covers more than one — cromanion_grants lists them and says whether it is required. Omitting it with several is refused rather than guessed at.

name: cromanion_disconnect_hubspot

changed.description: False when nothing was connected. That is a success, not a failure.

connected.description: Always false on success — the state after the call.

portalId.description: The portal that was severed. Present only when something was.
